items.story: Northwell Health President and CEO Dr. John D’Angelo tells Bloomberg This Weekend that the traditional US health care model is unsustainable and that improving affordability will require a greater focus on wellness, prevention and chronic disease. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Lisa Mateo, D’Angelo discusses workforce shortages, the financial pressures facing nonprofit hospitals and how AI could reduce administrative burdens while preserving the human role in consequential medical decisions.

items.story: സി.പി.എം വിശാല ജില്ല സമിതിക്ക് ഇന്ന് തുടക്കം; കൂടുതൽ ക്ഷണിതാക്കളെത്തും | Madhyamam Madhyamam‘പിണറായി വിജയനെയും മകളെയും മരുകനെയും സംരക്ഷിക്കേണ്ട ബാധ്യതയില്ല; ഇംഎംഎസിന്റെ പാർട്ടിയാണെന്ന് ഓർക്കണം’ Manorama Onlineസജി ചെറിയാന്റെ അന്തവും കുന്തവുമില്ലാത്ത പ്രസ്താവനകൾ പാർട്ടിക്ക് വളരെയേറെ ദോഷംചെയ്തു; കൊല്ലത്ത് വിമർശനം Mathrubhumiകൊല്ലം സിപിഎമ്മിലെ വിഭാഗീയത; തരംതാഴ്ത്തിയ പി.ആർ വസന്തനടക്കം 4 പേരെയും ജില്ലാ കമ്മിറ്റിയിൽ തിരിച്ചെടുത്തു Asianet News Malayalamമകള്‍ക്കായി കരിമണല്‍ കമ്പനിയില്‍നിന്ന് പണം വാങ്ങു

items.story: Eating blueberries every day could have surprising effects on mood, according to a small study that found greater reductions in depressive symptoms among older adults who consumed the fruit for three months. Researchers also detected changes in gut microbial enzymes, suggesting a possible gut-brain connection, although the mood benefits were not statistically significant compared with a placebo.

items.headline: Hybrid diamond chip strengthens interactions between light and quantum bits
items.teaser: Researchers have developed and demonstrated a new hybrid photonic platform that integrates quantum emitters with photonic devices, provid…
items.story: Researchers have developed and demonstrated a new hybrid photonic platform that integrates quantum emitters with photonic devices, providing a way to reliably control the interaction between photons and quantum information carriers. The chip-based platform, which combines gallium phosphide (GaP) with a diamond substrate, could help make quantum networks more practical by providing a way to connect quantum devices over long distances.

items.headline: Magic mushroom ingredient takes the fight out of aggressive fish
items.teaser: A psychedelic compound found in magic mushrooms appears to have an unexpected effect: calming highly aggressive fish. Researchers discove…
items.story: A psychedelic compound found in magic mushrooms appears to have an unexpected effect: calming highly aggressive fish. Researchers discovered that low doses of psilocybin significantly reduced aggressive attacks in mangrove rivulus fish without disrupting their normal social interactions. The findings suggest psilocybin may selectively calm escalating aggression rather than simply suppressing all behavior.

items.headline: Scientists discover a surprising twist in Japan's 7,300-year-old volcanic apocalypse

items.story: A catastrophic volcanic eruption 7,300 years ago devastated Japan, but new research reveals that its impact on prehistoric populations was far more complex than previously believed. While some communities disappeared or declined, others unexpectedly flourished as survivors migrated, adapted, and found new ways to thrive.

items.headline: Scientists uncover 3 key brain pathways linked to lasting depression relief
items.teaser: Researchers have uncovered three brain pathways linked to lasting improvements in people receiving deep brain stimulation for severe, tre…
items.story: Researchers have uncovered three brain pathways linked to lasting improvements in people receiving deep brain stimulation for severe, treatment-resistant depression. The findings suggest that millimeters in electrode placement could make a major difference in treatment outcomes.

items.headline: ‘ఓటు చోరీ’కి వాళ్లు మూల్యం చెల్లించుకుంటారు - రాహుల్
items.teaser: Rahul Gandhi: ‘ఓటు చోరీ’కి వాళ్లు మూల్యం చెల్లించుకుంటారు - రాహుల్ Eenadu‘మీకు నిద్రలేని రాత్రులు గడుపుతున్నారని తెలుసు.. రాజీనామా చేసేలా…
items.story: Rahul Gandhi: ‘ఓటు చోరీ’కి వాళ్లు మూల్యం చెల్లించుకుంటారు - రాహుల్ Eenadu‘మీకు నిద్రలేని రాత్రులు గడుపుతున్నారని తెలుసు.. రాజీనామా చేసేలా చేస్తాం’.. జ్ఞానేశ్‌ కుమార్‌కు రాహుల్‌ గాంధీ హెచ్చరిక AP7AMరేపు సుప్రీంకోర్టుకు కాంగ్రెస్ మార్చ్: రాహుల్ గాంధీ Sakshiరాజ్యాంగ పరిరక్షణే థ్యేయం.. హస్తిన వీధుల్లో విపక్ష పోరాటం.. Telugu Timesదేశ ప్రజలంతా మాతో ఉన్నారు- జ్ఞానేశ్‌ రాజీనామా చేసే వరకు నిరసనలు: రాహుల్‌ ETV Bharat
